name: BOURBON
ingredients_raw: Refined Wheat Flour (Maida), Sugar (33%), Refined Palm Oil, Edible Maize Starch, Colours (150a, 150d, 122, 110, 133 & 102), Cocoa Solids (2.7%), Milk Solids, Raising Agents [500(ii) & 503(ii)], Nature Identical & Artificial (Vanilla, Chocolate Milk & Milky Cocoa) Flavouring Substances, Emulsifiers [471 & 322(i)], Milk Chocolate (0.1%) [Emulsifier (322(i))] and Iodised Salt.
